adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.challenge: The lane is called LIVE FEED, and the feed re-reads a snapshot that will not move. Is the requirement actually met, or is this a refresh button on a timer?
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.answer: Half met, and the console says which half. county_facet_coverage moves only when an engine block or scorer runs; no recompute route exists on the deployed cortex-api (verified 2026-08-19: /api/serving-sweep returns HTTP 200 text/html 918 bytes, the SPA fallthrough; SS-W6 verified the same for /api/county-ledger/recompute and /refresh). What this lane can deliver is a console that re-reads continuously, states that a re-read which does not move computedAt is STALENESS and not a refresh, and picks up a fresh materialization the instant SS-W7's recompute route lands. Making the DATA live is SS-W7's half and is named as such rather than papered over.
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.disposition: kept, with the limitation on screen and in the close

adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.challenge: The declared work horizon is a hand-declared list — the exact rot class this lane is deleting elsewhere. Why is it not hypocrisy?
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.answer: It is the same class and it is treated as such: rendered with provenance 'declared', carrying a declaredAt and the doc_repo artifact path, sitting beside two checks that need no declaration. It earns its place because it is the only check that can name the specific work a snapshot predates, which is what nobody could see when the stale footprint reading was reported as world-truth. It is also DELIBERATELY UNDER-DECLARED: the same source line claims 174 counties for rrc-wells, and that is NOT declared, because the ledger's own capability probe serves maxCountiesReachable 1 for that rail and standing memory records the Harris-only finding. A contested claim is not put in a console's mouth.
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.disposition: kept, bounded, and the omission is documented in the source

adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.challenge: The written instrument observed the store on 2026-08-04, TEN DAYS OLDER than the ledger. Does comparing them prove anything?
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.answer: It proves presence against an asserted absence, which is a valid finding in one direction only, and the console states the direction. If the store held 233,249 zoning atoms on 2026-08-04 and the ledger computed on 2026-08-14 says 0.00% not-yet, the ledger is not describing what the store held before it ran. What it does NOT prove is a magnitude, which is why no arithmetic crosses that boundary. Both timestamps travel with every such finding.
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.disposition: kept; the asymmetry is asserted by test

adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.challenge: Deriving isPartial changes what the grid draws. Is that a silent reinterpretation of the API?
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.answer: It changes 120 of 3,556 cells from a blank dot to a number, and the change is declared in three places: the legend entry reads 'DERIVED', the derivation strip prints derived-vs-served side by side with their disagreement count, and the removed-controls list names the served field it replaced. The SATISFIED COUNT is deliberately NOT switched — it stays on the server's own isSatisfiedCell so the console's headline can never disagree with summary.satisfiedCells. Visual derivation, arithmetic left alone.
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.disposition: kept; the paired-control divergence is measured rather than resolved silently

adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.challenge: Scoring against the reachable ceiling produced mud 209/186, a fraction above one.
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.answer: Caught during the build and fixed at the root rather than clamped. An ESTABLISHED ABSENCE is not bounded by how far an acquisition source reaches — a county can be honestly recorded as having no MUD whether or not the MUD ingest covers it. So acquisition (134) scores against reach (186) and the 75 absences are counted beside it, never inside the fraction. Where acquisition alone would still exceed the ceiling the header flags it, because then the capability probe and the coverage scorer cannot both be right.
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.disposition: fixed; both directions asserted by test

adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.challenge: The written probe is not auto-run, so the operator still has to click to see the store. Does that repeat the defect this lane exists to fix?
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.answer: It is a deliberate trade with the evidence behind it. Two probes on 2026-08-19: HTTP 200 with 6,177 bytes, then HTTP 000 after 240 seconds. Auto-running it on mount would hang the panel that is supposed to be the live feed. What the console does instead is answer on sight WITHOUT it: the subtab badge reads 'store unread', the layer card says what the instrument is and why it is on demand, and the staleness alarm fires from the ledger alone. The operator's actual question — were footprints ingested — is answered on sight by the work-horizon alarm, since no written instrument covers the footprint rail at all and the console says that too.
adversarialReviewOfMyOwnWork.disposition: kept; the trade and its evidence are recorded
